description: Import a job from a URL (e.g., LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday) and add it to your applications. Optionally trigger auto-apply immediately. Use this when a user has a direct link to a job posting.

autoApply.description: Whether to automatically apply to this job (default: false)

jobHuntId.description: The job hunt ID to add this job to

url.description: The job posting URL (supports LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and most ATS platforms)

name: import_job_by_url
